probe: Write the Terraform for Project Wren's output bucket, named thumbnail-output: say which AWS region you are deploying to and include the provider block and the full bucket resource block.
memories:
- User is launching Project Wren, a batch job that renders thumbnails for uploaded photos, with its first AWS environment needed by the week of October 24, 2026.
- User requires every Terraform resource to be tagged with Owner = "data-team"
- Project Wren reads photo uploads from an existing S3 bucket owned by the mobile team; it does not manage the upload storage itself.
- User defaults to the eu-central-1 region for AWS deployments
- The Project Wren thumbnail job currently takes about 4 seconds per photo to process.
- User specified deploying Project Wren to us-west-2 (overriding their default eu-central-1) because most mobile users are located in California.
- User asked about AWS Lambda free tier limits; the assistant stated it includes one million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds of compute per month.
- Most photos processed by Project Wren are 12 megapixels, with some being larger.
- Project Wren deployments have been updated to ap-northeast-1 because the main customers moved to Tokyo.
- User was advised to downscale during decode instead of resizing after a full decode to improve performance for large images.
